board: SparkFun Ambient Light Sensor Breakout - APDS-9301 (SEN-14350)
reason: Check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test CH0=2500 CH1=800 Lux=712.9, PCB DRC clean). Driver follows AV02-2315EN: command byte 0x80|reg, power up with 0x03 and read it back, ID nibble 0101, TIMING gain/integ, Read Word 0xAC/0xAE low byte first, and the datasheet's CH1/CH0 lux formula with gain/integration scaling and saturation detection.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://cdn.sparkfun.com/assets/learn_tutorials/6/8/6/header_highlighted.png (silkscreen INT, GND, 3.3V, SDA, SCL) and schematic https://cdn.sparkfun.com/assets/9/c/2/4/9/APDS-9301_Breakout_v10.pdf
